atAGlance: Trà ô long is oolong tea, roasted, honeyed, or floral depending on the brew, and useful when plain tea still wants aroma.
whatItIs: Trà ô long is oolong tea served plain, iced, or café-style. Expect oolong tea with a roasted, honeyed, or floral taste depending on the brew.
howToEnjoy: Try it less sweet first; oolong has enough aroma to stand on its own.
howLocalsOrder: Trà ô long is ordered by temperature and sweetness. Ask ít đường or ít đá before the glass is made, because Vietnamese tea drinks can arrive sweeter and icier than expected.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Trà ô long sits between green and black tea on Vietnamese menus, useful when you want fragrance without milk.
goodToKnow: Ask whether it is plain tea or a sweet café drink.
